model_authored_provenance_marker: Originally authored inline in run_mafs_gf.py::_search_orders() (v1+v2 replay). Externalized per `MAFS-SKILL-1.0-PHASE-3-FINAL-v0.1` §2 (planning artifact emission) and §3 (driver consumption rule). The model retains scientific planning meaning; the driver only executes what this artifact specifies.

axes.rationale: von Reyn et al. 2014 introduced the GF spike-timing framework the user references; Crossref is the authoritative identity source for that paper.
Namiki et al. 2018 is the canonical nomenclature primary source for descending neurons including DNp01/GF identity.
Verify whether a 'von Reyn 2020 GF paper' exists; this is the negative-branch slot of the narrative.
Scheffer et al. 2020 hemibrain connectome paper is the most-cited reference for the GF lineage after the 2014 framework.
Dataset-entity identity (FlyWire / VFB / hemibrain body IDs) is outside the MAFS scholarly stack scope; the entity-anchor route is held as RESERVE_CONDITIONAL.

search_orders.note: Q5 is ENTITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED. The MAFS scholarly stack has no dataset adapter for FlyWire / VFB / hemibrain body IDs. The driver MUST short-circuit Q5 per Phase 2 lineage_glue contract; no discovery ladder is emitted for Q5.

consumption_rule.read_pattern: model authors planning -> write mafs_planning.json -> driver reads mafs_planning.json -> MAFS executes what the artifact specifies
consumption_rule.forbidden: hard-coding the effective scientific plan only inside _search_orders()
consumption_rule.allowed: small deterministic parser/adapter to execute the artifact; it may NOT reinterpret or improve scientific meaning

notes: This artifact records planning the model authored for the GF/EM narrative. It is NOT a new CQC authority object, NOT a new MAFS schema owner, and NOT a deterministic planning product (per advisory §4).

Q5's search_order has a `null` search_intent and query_re by design — the driver's Q5 short-circuit (per lineage_glue.md) reads `expected_doi == null` and `query_re == null` to recognize the entity-resolution boundary.
Axis/SearchOrder IDs are stable identifiers; the SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the Phase 3-Final trace (dsh_integration_trace_v3.json) and the closeout note (per advisory §16).

If a real DSH session changes the selection (e.g., user picks only Q1 and Q3 in the current replay), the driver MUST consume the new selection from this artifact (or a successor artifact), NOT a pre-seeded list from the earlier GF run (per advisory §9).
